identifier.value: Clearly AI Security & Privacy Assessment Platform

product.name: Clearly AI Security & Privacy Assessment Platform
product.description: An AI-native platform that automates security, privacy, and compliance assessments to reduce manual work and accelerate review cycles.

identifier.value: Automated Threat Modeling and Design Reviews

product.name: Automated Threat Modeling and Design Reviews
product.description: A feature that analyzes architecture and design documents to identify security risks and generate mitigation plans early in development.

identifier.value: Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs) and AI Governance Reviews

product.name: Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs) and AI Governance Reviews
product.description: Automates the generation of regulator-ready privacy documentation, including PIAs, DPIAs, and AI governance compliance reports.

product.name: Vendor Risk Assessments
product.description: Automates evaluation of third-party vendors’ security and privacy risks to support compliance and risk management.

product.name: Compliance Documentation and Audit Readiness
product.description: Generates structured, audit-ready compliance reports aligned with frameworks like ISO, NIST, PCI-DSS, and supports real-time risk tracking.

product.name: Secure Code Reviews
product.description: Automates detection of security vulnerabilities directly within codebases to support secure software development.
